title: SIS Read-Only — State Assessment Paused

transcript.speaker: Assessment Coordinator
transcript.text: DSS, this is the Assessment Coordinator at Halverson High. The SIS is now read-only—test admins can’t submit scores or change settings. We’re using the 05:00 offline roster to verify student locations. Chloe Mendez is in the library, 11th-grade testing is paused. We need to confirm whether the test window will be extended or rescheduled.

transcript.speaker: DSS
transcript.text: Understood. Confirm the 05:00 offline roster is being used for accountability. Pause all test submissions. I will notify the Policy Group and activate EOP Section 10: School-Day Continuity per HUSD-EOP-2026.

instructorNote: Operational friction inject; the Assessment Coordinator confirms the SIS is read-only and the test pause. The DSS must activate EOP Section 10 and notify the Policy Group.
